arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE daily_changes AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        t.txn_date AS balance_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE -t.txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS t
    GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.txn_date
),
customer_starts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(balance_date) AS first_date
    FROM daily_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- Carry balances forward through the last date in the transaction data.
calendar(balance_date) AS (
    SELECT MIN(balance_date) FROM daily_changes
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(balance_date, '+1 day')
    FROM calendar
    WHERE balance_date < (SELECT MAX(balance_date) FROM daily_changes)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        c.balance_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', s.first_date) AS baseline_month,
        SUM(COALESCE(d.net_change, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.customer_id
            ORDER BY c.balance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS balance
    FROM customer_starts AS s
    JOIN calendar AS c ON c.balance_date >= s.first_date
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS d
        ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id AND d.balance_date = c.balance_date
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', balance_date) AS month,
        baseline_month,
        AVG(balance) OVER last_30_days AS average_balance,
        COUNT(*) OVER last_30_days AS days_in_window
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW last_30_days AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY balance_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
customer_monthly_maxima AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month, MAX(MAX(average_balance, 0.0)) AS maximum_average_balance
    FROM rolling_balances
    WHERE days_in_window = 30 AND month > baseline_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT month, SUM(maximum_average_balance) AS total_max_30_day_average_balance
FROM customer_monthly_maxima
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
